attempts.summary: Deployed a systemd-managed background service `inventory-worker` on node1, running as a dedicated unprivileged system user, sandboxed with NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, and ReadWritePaths restricted to /var/lib/inventory. Verified confinement (write to /etc fails, write to /var/lib/inventory succeeds) and confirmed the service survives a full node reboot: enabled at boot, auto-restarted, boot ID changed, and worker log continued appending after restart.
